instruction: Read orders.csv and customers.csv. Inner join orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id. Sum orders.amount for joined rows with customers.region equal to 'north'. Each matching pair contributes once. Print the integer total.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(o.amount AS INTEGER)),0) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.region='north'

instruction: Read sales.csv and tags.csv. Inner join on their key columns. Sum sales.units for every matching pair whose tags.tag is 'keep'. Repeated rows are distinct matches: do not deduplicate or retain only one tag per key. Print the integer sum.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(s.units AS INTEGER)),0) FROM sales s JOIN tags t ON s.key=t.key WHERE t.tag='keep'

instruction: Read orders.csv and payments.csv. Left join orders.order_id to payments.order_id. Each matched payment contributes its amount; unmatched orders contribute zero. Ignore payments for unknown orders. Sum the contributions and print the integer total.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(p.amount AS INTEGER)),0) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_id=p.order_id

instruction: Read orders.csv and regions.csv. Join on key using exact string equality: '01' and '1' are different keys. Sum orders.units for matching region 'north'. Preserve leading zeroes in keys. Print the integer total.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(o.units AS INTEGER)),0) FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON o.key=r.key WHERE r.region='north'

instruction: Read customers.csv and invoices.csv. Count customer rows whose customer_id never appears in invoices.customer_id. Repeated invoices must not change whether a customer is counted. Ignore invoices for unknown customers. Print the integer count.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.customer_id=c.customer_id)

instruction: Read numbers.csv. Print the median of all values in column value as an integer.
sql: SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM numbers ORDER BY CAST(value AS INTEGER) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
